title: Opinions of current bands and rock and roll
summary: After off-topic chatter, Trotter says the arrangers were all good, mentions Larry's band and says he dislikes rock and roll.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
